player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id}. Wo reko FifteenPuzzle agoro no.
Agoro no botae ne sɛ wo bɛtumi ayɛ ɔha no sɛ wɔ bɛbaa wɔ nkrataa mu wɔ kɔlaa mu fi 1 kosi 15, na faako a ɛwɔ fam ne nifa so.
Sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo yɛ biribi, wo tumi fa tile bi bɛkɔ mu (wɔkɔ akyerɛ mu akyerɛ pɛn, e.g. __) a wo bɛyɛ nea edi kan no mu:
- 'up': Fa tile a ɛwɔ fam no bɛkɔ soro.
- 'down': Fa tile a ɛwɔ soro no bɛkɔ fam.
- 'left': Fa tile a ɛwɔ nifa so no bɛkɔ benkum.
- 'right': Fa tile a ɛwɔ benkum no bɛkɔ nifa so.
Sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo kyerɛ wo biribi no, kyerɛ kɔkɔɔ no (e.g., 'up', 'down', 'left', anaa 'right') wɔ nsate mu, e.g. [up].
Sɛnea agoro no mu te sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ akyerɛ wɔ ha.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nsakrae a enni mu. Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} antumi amfa ɔkwan pa biara amma wɔ ntweaseɛ no so.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Nsakrae a enni mu. Ntontom no ntumi ntwe wɔ ɔkwan a wɔahyɛ so ho.

outcome.win: Anigyesɛm! Agorɔfoɔ {player_id} adi nkonim wɔ 15-Puzzle no mu.
outcome.turn_limit: Wɔabedu nea wɔatwa no so. Nea ɔhwɛ mu yɛ adwuma a, ne nyinaa bɛyɛ {percent} ɔha biara mu nkyem biako na wawie
